intro: Every property is different, so every price is quoted after we have looked at it. The visit and the written estimate are free. Our goal is to work within your budget while still doing a superior job — and you will never get an invoice for work you did not agree to first.

packages.name: Lawn & Landscape Maintenance
includes: Weeding of flower beds and mulching
Blades sharpened daily for the best cut

packages.name: Tree Service
includes: Palm tree trimming and full removals
Licensed, insured crews to OSHA and ISA standards

packages.name: Sod Installation
includes: Site measured and prepared before delivery
Watering-in guidance for the first weeks
An established lawn in days, not a season of seed

notes: We do not publish a rate card, and you should be wary of anyone in this trade who does. What a lawn costs depends on the lot size, the slope, the number of beds and how far behind it has fallen; what a tree costs depends on its size, its species, what is underneath it and whether a lift can reach it. We come out, look at the actual property, and hand you a written number — at no charge and with no obligation. Call (305) 333-2642 or request an estimate and we will schedule the visit.
